title: Asymptotic Calculus Catalogue row schema (v1)
description: One chain-verified self-validating row in the srmech asymptotic_calculus catalog. Each row encodes an input (x_num, x_den, num_terms) and the ground-truth output (expected_num, expected_den) of the named operator chain. CI runs the chain and bit-exact-compares the produced output to the stored expected output. Per [[feedback_every_doc_edit_faces_falsification]] (2026-05-16) — the canonical mechanism by which project doc claims are falsified or validated via class-operator chain composition.

row_label.description: Human-readable identifier for the row, e.g. 'exp_half_N10'.

row_type.description: Taxonomy of the chain operation. Initially only 'partial_sum_truncation' (rc6); future rcs add 'forward_difference', 'riemann_sum', 'continued_fraction_convergent', etc.

kind.description: Transcendental being computed. rc8 shipped 'exp'; rc11 added 'sin', 'cos', 'log1p', 'atan'. Future rcs add 'tan', 'sinh', 'cosh', 'arcsin', 'bessel_j', 'gamma', 'digamma', 'zeta'.

x_num.description: Numerator p of input x = p/q. May be negative.

x_den.description: Denominator q of input x = p/q. Must be positive.

num_terms.description: Truncation parameter N; the partial sum includes terms k = 0..N.

expected_num.description: Ground-truth numerator of the chain's output rational in lowest terms. Produced by running the chain at catalog author time (2026-05-16). Any drift in the underlying Class N + Class J primitives surfaces as immediate test failure.

expected_den.description: Ground-truth denominator of the chain's output rational in lowest terms; always positive.

chain_id.description: Name of the operator chain in this catalog's descriptor.toml that produced the expected output.

source_apostol.description: Apostol *Mathematical Analysis* reference for the Lagrange remainder bound supporting the partial-sum convergence claim.

source_bishop.description: Bishop *Foundations of Constructive Analysis* reference for the asymptotic-rate / constructive-analysis stance.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 publication date of the canonical SSoT cited for this row (Apostol *Mathematical Analysis* 2nd ed., 1974). Required by the literature_curated adapter for per-row attestation.

entered_locally_at.description: Date (UTC) this row was added to the catalog.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the row, e.g. float-view of the rational, residual bound, etc.
